login.heading: sign in
login.intro: Enter the admin password configured as ADMIN_PASSWORD on this server.

errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Slow down for a moment and try again.
errors.CSRF_REJECTED: The request was refused for security reasons. Reload the page and try again.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: The server did not accept that input.
errors.SERVER_ERROR: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
errors.NETWORK: The server could not be reached. Check your connection.

toolbar.searchPlaceholder: Search page, title, source, note, event…

limit.one: At most {count} view can be selected at once.
limit.other: At most {count} views can be selected at once.

table.selectPage: Select every view on this page

retention.one: Views in the trash no longer count in any statistic. They are erased permanently {count} day after being deleted, or sooner if you erase them here.
retention.other: Views in the trash no longer count in any statistic. They are erased permanently {count} days after being deleted, or sooner if you erase them here.

trash.retentionOff: Views in the trash no longer count in any statistic. Automatic erasure is off (TRASH_RETENTION_DAYS=0), so they stay until erased here.

editedPartial.one: Edited {count} view; {skipped} skipped because they are in the trash or gone.
editedPartial.other: Edited {count} views; {skipped} skipped because they are in the trash or gone.

noteSavedPartial.one: Saved the note on {count} view; {skipped} no longer exist.
noteSavedPartial.other: Saved the note on {count} views; {skipped} no longer exist.

noteClearedPartial.one: Cleared the note on {count} view; {skipped} no longer exist.
noteClearedPartial.other: Cleared the note on {count} views; {skipped} no longer exist.

deletedPartial.one: Moved {count} view to the trash; {skipped} were already there.
deletedPartial.other: Moved {count} views to the trash; {skipped} were already there.

restoredPartial.one: Restored {count} view; {skipped} were not in the trash.
restoredPartial.other: Restored {count} views; {skipped} were not in the trash.

purgedPartial.one: Erased {count} view permanently; {skipped} were not in the trash.
purgedPartial.other: Erased {count} views permanently; {skipped} were not in the trash.

deleteMessage.one: It stops counting in every statistic at once. You can restore it from the trash within {days} days, after which it is erased for good.
deleteMessage.other: They stop counting in every statistic at once. You can restore them from the trash within {days} days, after which they are erased for good.

deleteMessageNoRetention.one: It stops counting in every statistic at once. You can restore it from the trash at any time.
deleteMessageNoRetention.other: They stop counting in every statistic at once. You can restore them from the trash at any time.

purgeMessage.one: This removes the view from the database for good. It cannot be restored. The admin log keeps a record that it was erased, but none of its content.
purgeMessage.other: This removes the views from the database for good. They cannot be restored. The admin log keeps a record that they were erased, but none of their content.

edit.introSingle: Change a field and it is saved. The view is then marked as modified by an admin.

introBatch.one: Tick each field to overwrite on the selected view. Unticked fields are left alone.
introBatch.other: Tick each field to overwrite on all {count} selected views. Unticked fields are left alone.

edit.lockedNotice: What was observed about the visitor (time, masked IP, country, browser, device type) can never be edited. The source is recalculated from the referrer.
edit.nothingSelected: Choose at least one field to change.

note.intro: A private annotation for admins. Adding a note does not mark a view as modified.
